blockers: MMRDR Figshare metadata exposes the ten future-download file IDs and sizes, but the current API response exposes no MD5 values and no SHA-256 values; the exact archive provenance is therefore not frozen.

MMRDR data-record licensing reports CC BY 4.0 while the associated Scientific Data article page carries CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 article copyright; the scope of the data license and cloud-use terms must be reconciled before execution.
MMRDR UWF split is described as patient-level, but the published CSV description does not provide row-level patient IDs; the train/validation identity audit cannot be completed from checked evidence.

IDRiD's official page displays CC BY 4.0 and verifies the 516-image grading set plus the four lesion mask families, but the exact IEEE archive/file inventory and SHA-256 provenance have not been obtained.

IDRiD mask coverage is class-dependent (MA 81, EX 81, HE 80, SE 40) and the official evidence does not establish exhaustive absence semantics; clean negative ROI eligibility therefore remains unresolved.

C0 has an exact upstream checkpoint URL but no locally verified weight hash or execution-time asset card; C1 has a fixed Hub revision but no local weight hash and documented pretraining overlap with IDRiD, OIA-DDR, and EyePACS; C2 has gated access, no local weight hash, and unresolved source-image overlap in the LVD-1689M web corpus.
